status: FINAL for the first build (2026-11-18). Servo angle limits: every end clear by >= 0.5 mm on the exact parts (tools/blender/clearance_sweep.py). Combinations a per-joint limit cannot block: 'interlocks' (clear by >= 0.3 mm, the sweep tool's accuracy floor). Human-readable: JOINT_LIMITS.md.

interlocks._signs: degrees from each joint's zero, MJCF signs. Rules written in the LEFT leg's signs; for the right leg flip the sign of every hip/knee/ankle angle before applying.

head_roll_yaw.rule: head roll may leave 0 only while abs(head_yaw) <= 1.0; head yaw may leave 0 only while abs(head_roll) <= 1.0

knee_ankle.rule: with the knee bent past +30 (left signs), ankle >= the value for the next row at or above the knee angle (the stricter neighbour)

both_legs.rule: never both legs forward of hip pitch -30 (left signs) while both hips are toed out (hip yaw > 0, left signs)

hip_maps.rule: allowed hip roll by hip pitch x hip yaw x knee, ONE MAP PER LEG (the right is not a mirror); between grid values use the stricter neighbour; a cell's roll is also capped by the servo limit (+18.5)
hip_maps.data: data/hip_collision_map.json: poses (left), right_poses (right, in left signs), margin 0.3 mm
hip_maps.ankle_raised: with the ankle at +-23 extra cells collide: data/hip_collision_map.json ankle_pm23_left / ankle_pm23_right

sit_stand.rule: sit / stand only along the checked path: STAND <-> SIT in a straight joint-space line, >= 3 s each way, IMU ankle balance on

notes.sit_2026_11_13: SIT replaced (the original's hip -30 / knee 60 cannot be reached with the feet flat: it needs the trunk pitched ~90 deg and face-plants). New SIT = feet flat, trunk leaned back ~31 deg onto its tail: hip pitch 70, knee 18, ankle -16 (left; right mirrored), hip roll / neck / head as STAND. Found by a quasi-static search (CoM over the soles >= 15.5 mm all the way from STAND, static torque <= 60 %) and checked in MuJoCo: 108/108 variations pass (move 1.5-3 s, friction 0.4-1.0, servo stiffness x0.5-1, trunk CoM +-6 mm, trunk mass +15 %); trunk down on the floor in all; peak servo load 61 % median / 69 % max at 3 s per move (80 % max at 1.5 s). Use 3 s moves.
